text: what about this fire hydrant [Image #16] and also this bush is not smooth like the game has it in the editor so there is some disconnect [Image #17] [Image #18]
resolution: Both prop disconnects fixed (commit fd88026a4). (1) Fire hydrant: worldGeometry's propParts had no fireHydrant case, so the compiled bake shipped the box fallback — one red box. The live model (render3d/props/FireHydrant.tsx) is now transcribed into compiled parts: base flange, barrel, dome, bonnet, cap nut, front pumper, two side outlets; the bake's instance count moved +7 exactly as expected (8 parts replace 1 box). (2) Faceted bushes: the loader's sphere/cylinder mesh builders assigned one normal per triangle (flat shading) where the editor's geometry registry uses per-vertex normals — spheres now shade fully smooth and cylinder barrels smooth around the rim with flat caps, matching the editor look. rjit game shot GREEN with 17061 instances; worldGeometry tests 4/4. Verify: rjit game play — the hydrant should be a real hydrant and bushes should read as smooth blobs like /test.
